_what: Overnight run snapshot. The firing cron copies this into run_request.json and pushes.
_desc: A4 — the floor map across six inexpensive models, ten one-turn probes, n=25.
_frozen_by: teacherbot@blue, 2026-08-01, with the utterance 'if we get results we can just put in another $20'.
_precondition_met: The contract said 'Stop if the cap holds less.' A3 reported $0.4208, so loop spend is 3.2990 of the 5.50 cap and headroom is 2.2010 against this run's 1.25. Confirmed from bytes, not from the estimate.
_luna_is_a_control: luna's cells repeat runs 30673119035 and 30673947703. Predictions committed BEFORE staging at registry/probes/A4-prereg.json. A3 already replicated luna on eleven probes with 0 of 11 outside interval; this adds P2, P2S, P10 and P16, which were never re-run.
_probe_selection: Ten probes, every one a single turn with no judge model. The five multi-turn probes were cut because they resend a ~4.2K-token prefix per turn; P5, P7 and P7S were cut because they call a judge, adding a second price and a dependency outside the roster.
_ceiling_is_a_loss: $1.25 against an estimate of ~$0.55 on A2's measured per-cell basis. The estimator erred 22% low then 184% high, so this is what can be absorbed, not what is predicted.
